name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.filteredTriplesExec_eq
typeText:
∀ (γ : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance) (hv : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.Valid γ) (n : Nat)
  (I :
    DisequalityDispersion.Interpretation (Fin (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.m γ))
      (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.arity γ) (Fin n))
  (d : Fin n),
  Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.filteredTriplesExec γ hv n I d)
    (DisequalityDispersion.filteredTriples (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.xv γ hv)
      (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.yv γ hv) (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.outTerm γ hv)
      (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.testTerms γ hv) I)

source.code:
theorem filteredTriplesExec_eq (hv : γ.Valid) (n : ℕ)
    (I : Interpretation (Fin γ.m) γ.arity (Fin n)) (d : Fin n) :
    γ.filteredTriplesExec hv n I d =
      filteredTriples (γ.xv hv) (γ.yv hv) (γ.outTerm hv) (γ.testTerms hv) I := by
  classical
  have ht := (γ.valid_iff.mp hv).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
  ext o
  simp only [filteredTriplesExec, validAssignmentsExec, filteredTriples, validAssignments,
    Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨a, (γ.passesTests_iff hv I a d).mp ha, ?_⟩
    rw [γ.evalNodes_getD hv I a d γ.t ht]
    rfl
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨a, (γ.passesTests_iff hv I a d).mpr ha, ?_⟩
    rw [γ.evalNodes_getD hv I a d γ.t ht]
    rfl
